name: Meeting Brief Assistant
summary: An agentic web app that automatically sends a Slack brief before each calendar meeting containing attendee email threads, PDF agenda summaries, and talking points.

items.title: Calendar integration
items.description: Reads upcoming meetings from your calendar to trigger the brief generation.
items.proved_when: The system successfully fetches upcoming meetings and attendee lists.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

items.title: Slack message sender
items.description: Sends the generated meeting brief directly to your Slack workspace.
items.proved_when: A message is successfully posted to Slack before a meeting.

items.title: Email thread retriever
items.description: Retrieves the last email thread with each meeting attendee.
items.proved_when: The last email thread per attendee is successfully fetched.

items.title: Meeting brief generator
items.description: Summarizes attached agenda PDFs and generates three relevant talking points.
items.proved_when: An agent processes the agenda PDF and creates talking points and summaries.
items.source_quote: a summary of any attached agenda PDF, and three talking points

items.title: Pre-meeting scheduler
items.description: Triggers the brief creation and delivery prior to the scheduled meeting time.
items.proved_when: Briefs are sent automatically before meetings start.
items.source_quote: Before each meeting on my calendar

questions.text: Which Slack workspace should this post to?
How far in advance of each meeting should the brief arrive in Slack?

not_in_this_version.title: Custom PDF templates
not_in_this_version.reason: Keeping the scope focused on text summaries and talking points in Slack.
